revenue_scope: Worldwide (US + Intl) 'OTHER' line of J&J's Cardiovascular / Metabolism / Other franchise (the franchise's residual line after XARELTO), which holds PROCRIT / EPREX from 2022Q1 and INVOKANA from 2023Q1.
why_separate: J&J stopped printing PROCRIT / EPREX on its own line after 2021Q4 ('Other is inclusive of PROCRIT / EPREX, which was previously disclosed separately'); the continuation is the franchise's residual OTHER line, which holds other products and joined INVOKANA in 2023Q1. It is a broader line, not Procrit's own sales.
notes: Span 2022Q1-2026Q2. Composition of the line: footnote (3) of the 2022Q1 schedule says 'Other is inclusive of PROCRIT / EPREX, which was previously disclosed separately', and footnote (3) of the 2023Q1 schedule says 'Other is inclusive of INVOKANA, which was previously disclosed separately'. J&J printed INVOKANA / INVOKAMET on its own line through 2022Q4, so the 2022 'Other' rows (first printed 274, 243, 236, 213) include PROCRIT / EPREX but not INVOKANA, while the 2023Q1 schedule restates 2022 'Other' to 402, 363, 345, 304 (for 2022Q4 213 + INVOKANA / INVOKAMET 91 = 304). Each quarter is recorded as first printed, so the line steps up at 2023Q1 by the INVOKANA amount. The franchise is printed as 'CARDIOVASCULAR / METABOLISM / OTHER' and from 2026Q1 as 'CARDIOVASCULAR / METABOLISM / OTHER (CVM)'; the 'OTHER' row recorded is the one under that franchise (not 'OTHER CARDIOVASCULAR', a MedTech line). Annual checks: each Q4 schedule's twelve-month figure equals the sum of that year's four rows (2022 966, 2023 1,306, 2024 1,189, 2025 1,145). The 2026Q1 'Other' row (233 against a restated prior-year 323) falls with no footnote on the line; the cause is not stated by J&J. Other products in the line are not named by J&J.

Fetched each J&J schedule row from the document's own text: the first occurrence of the line's name line followed by its WW row (the main Reported Sales vs. Prior Period table, ahead of any supplemental table).
Searched the 49 schedule PDFs for PROCRIT: own line 2014Q3-2021Q4, then only the 2022Q1 footnote and supplemental table (the footnote text appears once); absent from every schedule 2022Q2-2026Q2.
Located the franchise's OTHER row in every schedule 2022Q1-2026Q2 and read the footnotes of the 2022Q1 and 2023Q1 schedules.
Partner/successor rung: EPREX outside the U.S. is sold by J&J subsidiaries (Janssen-Cilag) and PROCRIT in the U.S. by Janssen; no other issuer prints these sales as a quarterly line.
